claim.quote: The K^0_S and Lambda R_CP(p_T) are similar in shape to those measured at sqrt{s_NN} = 200 GeV at RHIC, though they are larger in absolute value.

name: NA57 central-to-peripheral nuclear modification factors in Pb-Pb collisions at 17.3 GeV

summary.plain: NA57 measured how the production of K0s, Lambda and other particles in central lead-lead collisions compares with peripheral ones, at the top SPS energy. The shape resembles RHIC results at 200 GeV but the values are larger.
summary.technical: Central-to-peripheral nuclear modification factors R_CP(pT) for K0s, Lambda, anti-Lambda and negatively charged particles at central rapidity in Pb-Pb at the top SPS energy, covering the 55% most central collisions; shape similar to 200 GeV RHIC measurements but larger in absolute value; K0s R_CP compared with a theoretical calculation.

title: Central-to-peripheral nuclear modification factors in Pb-Pb collisions at sqrt(s_NN) = 17.3 GeV
why_it_matters: Connects the SPS strangeness programme with the jet-quenching observables measured at RHIC and the LHC.
